targetJurisdictions: Invite-only technical canary users approved by the project operator
restrictedJurisdictions: All public jurisdictions until a separate public-launch legal approval is recorded
operatorLicensesOrExemptions: No public gambling jurisdiction is opened by this memo; approval is limited to project-controlled technical canary access with risk-in default off

accessControls.agePolicy: Frontend age and terms gate is required before casino entry; minimum age is 18 and any stricter jurisdiction rule must block risk-in
accessControls.kycPolicy: No public KYC policy is approved by this memo; production risk-in remains disabled for unknown or non-allowlisted users until a separate policy is approved
accessControls.sanctionsPolicy: Project operator must block sanctioned addresses and restricted users before enabling public risk-in; this memo only approves risk-in-disabled technical canary access
accessControls.geoRestrictionProvider: Application frontend defaults unknown and restricted jurisdictions to block-risk-in; a production geo provider must be approved before public launch
accessControls.vpnProxyPolicy: VPN and proxy users must be treated as unknown jurisdiction and blocked from risk-in until a separate policy is approved
accessControls.cookieConsentPolicy: Cookie consent UI is present; analytics and marketing cookies must remain optional and must not be required for wallet or support access
responsibleGamingControls: Responsible-gaming copy and support links are present in the frontend
Self-exclusion UI is present and must be honored before public risk-in
Stake-limit UI is present and must be honored before public risk-in
accessControls.selfExclusionPolicy: Self-exclusion controls are available in the frontend; excluded users must not be allowed to place casino bets
accessControls.stakeLimitPolicy: Stake-limit controls are available in the frontend; configured limits must fail closed before public risk-in is enabled

approvals.legalApproval: Project-owner approval for risk-in-disabled technical canary only; separate external legal approval required before broad public casino risk-in
approvals.complianceApproval: Project-owner approval for current fail-closed access controls; sanctions, geo, KYC, and jurisdiction policy must be re-approved before public risk-in
approvals.frontendApproval: Frontend launch-readiness pass completed with age gate, cookie consent, responsible-gaming surfaces, support page, legal pages, wallet gate, healthz, and proof surfaces present
approvals.operationsApproval: Docker production stack, primary keeper health, durable bet-index health, and /api/healthz are operational for technical canary; backup keeper and managed Postgres evidence remain required before broad public traffic
